items.justification: The answer is true and statement 1 (FACT) is true: percentFor checks the empty code, the active flag and the expiry (fixtures/acme-shop/app/Services/CouponValidator.php:18, fixtures/acme-shop/app/Services/CouponValidator.php:24, fixtures/acme-shop/app/Services/CouponValidator.php:28). Statement 2 (FACT) is overtyped: isRedeemable only returns percentFor(...) > 0.0 (fixtures/acme-shop/app/Services/CouponValidator.php:37), so 'verifies the code is valid' is an inference, not stated literally (an active, unexpired coupon with percent_off 0 would not be redeemable). One error out of two statements and no false FACT, so the verdict is partial.
